description.value: Sushi Wara is an authentic Japanese restaurant situated just off the Trans-Canada Highway in Ladysmith, operated since 2016 by master chef Paul Pak who brings 30 years of Japanese culinary experience. The restaurant uses fresh, local fish and offers both indoor dine-in and outdoor patio seating, giving cyclists a comfortable place to rest. Its highway-adjacent location makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms a real, active restaurant at 370 Trans-Canada Hwy, Ladysmith, BC since 2016, with matching phone number and address. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'Take-Out Menu' and 'take out' references; outdoor seating is confirmed on the About page. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are explicitly mentioned anywhere on the site.

OSM opening hours differ from hours shown on website — the website value should be considered more current.
